def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 100_000
    coupon_rate = 0.05
    initial_market_rate = coupon_rate
    new_market_rate = 0.06
    years_to_maturity = 10

    # Calculate the bond price at each market rate
    annual_coupon = face_value * coupon_rate

    initial_price = sum(
        annual_coupon / ((1 + initial_market_rate) ** year)
        for year in range(1, years_to_maturity + 1)
    ) + face_value / ((1 + initial_market_rate) ** years_to_maturity)

    new_price = sum(
        annual_coupon / ((1 + new_market_rate) ** year)
        for year in range(1, years_to_maturity + 1)
    ) + face_value / ((1 + new_market_rate) ** years_to_maturity)

    # Calculate percentage price change
    percentage_change = ((new_price - initial_price) / initial_price) * 100

    # Return the percentage change rounded to two decimal places
    return round(percentage_change, 2)
